verifiedBoundaries.observation: Copies the supplied previous object into a pooled object, then calls ReadFromStream with delta=true. Absent fields retain the copied baseline.
verifiedBoundaries.tokenLimit: The token is bound to the file hash above. An older ignored excerpt labels an equivalent method 060000D3; that token must not be used for this current hash.

verifiedBoundaries.observation: InputMessage and ModelState do not reset their whole destination at entry; only parsed fields are assigned. Nested vectors receive the delta flag. Vector3 explicitly skips clearing x/y/z when delta=true, so an empty vector submessage also preserves the old components.
verifiedBoundaries.consequence: A complete serializer that omits zero-valued fields, or an empty Input/ModelState/vector submessage, is not proof that an unknown previous tick has been completely overridden.

verifiedBoundaries.observation: The constructor initializes flags to 4, while ResetToPool writes flags=0. Pool reuse and a copied baseline prevent interpreting an empty ModelState as an invariant flags=4 value.

ProtoDelta decoding is followed by RecordPacket at IL_004B, copying lastReceivedTick at IL_0080 and OnReceiveTick at IL_00A5. RecordPacket can serialize the reconstructed tick before the sleep branch is reached.

requiredObjects.observation: Throws if inputState or modelState is null. A packet is not complete merely because the sleep branch does not use its position.

verifiedBoundaries.observation: After the receiving-snapshot, transfer, spectator and dead checks, the sleeping branch tests WasJustPressed for the accepted wake buttons. It calls EndSleeping at IL_00CE, immediately sends a network update, and returns at IL_00E8 after updating the active item. An already-awake path reaches UpdatePositionFromTick at IL_01C8.
verifiedBoundaries.consequence: The same first packet may enter the awake path if the server state changes before it arrives; a release packet following a successful wake also enters that path. The local early return does not justify omitting actual position, eyes and model state from a complete sequence.

The body then obtains the calling player and requires admin/developer or cinematic before locating the argument-selected sleeping target. Cinematic does not bypass the outer ServerAdmin check. This is not an ordinary own-player equivalent of respawn, and no RCON replacement or privilege change was attempted.
